finalText:
For a first adventure holiday, Slovenia in September is close to perfect: warm days, thin crowds, and a compact country where nothing is more than two hours from anything else. This 7-day Julian Alps plan mixes genuinely adventurous moments — a guided national-park walk, beginner rafting on the Soča — with soft landings every evening in family-run guesthouses (expect great breakfasts).

Nothing here needs prior experience or a head for heights, and every day has an easy bail-out option if legs are tired. September water levels make the rafting gentle, and the Vintgar Gorge boardwalks reopen fully after summer maintenance.

Estimated cost for two people: £1,350 total including flights from the UK, guesthouse B&B accommodation, the guided walk and rafting day — comfortably inside your £1,500 budget. Want me to search current flights to Ljubljana, or swap the rafting for a kayaking taster on Lake Bohinj?
